import pathlib,json,sys,tempfile,hashlib,os,numpy,scipy,yaml
names=['AGENTS.md','CLAUDE.md','CODEX.md','ops/e2e-test-plan.md','openspec/capabilities/research-reporting/spec.md','openspec/capabilities/verification/spec.md','scripts/experiment_template.py','python/carnot/reporting/primary_publication.py','ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml','openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-vNEXT.md','python/carnot/verify/sentence_energy_8183.py','python/carnot/verify/selective_energy_fit_8195.py','python/carnot/verify/selective_rule_8194.py','results/experiment_8182_v707_fit_sentence_capture.json','results/experiment_8195_v708_selective_energy_fit.json','results/experiment_8207_v709_restricted_action_methods.json']
for name in names:
 p=pathlib.Path(name); b=p.read_bytes();print(name,len(b),'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),flush=True)
 if p.suffix=='.json':
  d=json.loads(b);assert isinstance(d,dict);print('schema',d['experiment_id'],d['task_id'],d['required_checks_passed'],flush=True)
d=json.loads(pathlib.Path(names[-1]).read_bytes());assert d['action_protocol_ready_score']==1
p=pathlib.Path(d['protocol_path']);assert 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==d['protocol_sha256'];print('protocol authenticated',d['protocol_sha256'],flush=True)
for tool in ['python','pytest','coverage','ruff','mypy']:assert os.access('.venv/bin/'+tool,os.X_OK)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='carnot8208-probe-') as t:
 p=pathlib.Path(t)/'probe';p.write_bytes(b'private');assert p.read_bytes()==b'private';print('private scratch writable',t,flush=True)
print(sys.version,'numpy',numpy.__version__,'scipy',scipy.__version__,flush=True)
